_about: A weapon's refinement passive for the formula estimate (math-fallback P3, task 12). Every number is read from the seeded `weapon_refinements.param_list` of the wielder's refinement by index ({"param": i}); `pins` holds each refinement's list as curated, and a wielder whose list differs is withheld rather than read by a stale index. Structure is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's WR weapon sheet `go` at `go_commit` (MIT), lines per effect; gcsim's implementation at `gcsim_commit` where it has one. Validated by app/formula/genshin/weapon_passives.py.

conditions.label: Ode to Flowers stacks (Normal or Plunging Attack hits)
Ode at 2 stacks: the party bonus

effects.label: Ode: Elemental DMG per stack, every element
Party Elemental DMG per 1,000 of the wielder's DEF, to 3,200 DEF

unmodelled.what: the party bonus from the wielder's DEF including the Ode's own DEF%
unmodelled.reason: pass 1 carries no conditional weapon stat: the DEF it reads is the wielder's build without the Ode stacks, where GO's `total.def` has them

unmodelled.what: Millennial Movement / same-name buffs from two wielders
unmodelled.reason: GO lets only one of a kind apply (nonStackBuff); two wielders in one team are both applied here, which overstates that rare team
